text: The chart is in a fenced code block (so it stays aligned)
If the chart is framed, every line has the same display width
Only font-safe glyphs (ASCII, Latin-1, WGL4 box drawing, shades, half blocks, markers)
Losses grow left and gains right of one shared zero line
Bar lengths are proportional to the values (±1 cell of round(v / max × longest))
Every value is printed in the chart
